title: Emenegger gave a copy of the documentary to Spielberg

tellings.quote: "No, he didn't tell me what I didn't tell you. I gave a copy to Spielberg."

plain: A filmmaker named Bob Emenegger, who made the 1974 documentary UFOs: Past, Present and Future, gave a copy of it to Steven Spielberg in the years before Spielberg's film Close Encounters of the Third Kind, according to Grant Cameron, a UFO researcher who says Emenegger told him so. Cameron quotes Emenegger: 'I gave a copy to Spielberg', a link that, if true, would mean the documentary's material fed into the famous film.
